text:
tariq: Pushed tf-module/gpupool v2 to staging canary. gitops plan shows ~50 replaces, mainly kms_alias and gpupool defaults.

maya: wait, didn't we agree to keep kms alias backwards compatible? :thinking:

tariq: I thought so too. PR changed kms_alias from string -> object (region + name). Provider alias was added.

serena: saw this in canary logs: `Error: kms: Cross-region alias is not supported` in eu-west-1

liam: also noticed gpupool defaults changed min_size from 2 -> 4 and removed spot fallback. Cost estimate +65% on canary.

jen: argo/gotest pipeline failed during apply: `rpc error: code = Unknown desc = provider alias mismatch` — full logs: https://ci.company/1234

tariq: pushing a quick plan excerpt:
```
- module.gpupool.aws_kms_alias.alias
-/+ resource "aws_kms_alias" "alias" {
-  name = "alias/redwood/gpupool"
-  target_key_id = aws_kms_key.pool_key.id
+  name = "alias/${var.kms.region}/${var.kms.name}"
+  target_key_id = aws_kms_key.pool_key.id
 }
```

maya: Oof. Two problems: 1) breaking change to alias shape, 2) provider alias created without migration steps.

serena: can we add compatibility by keeping old `var.kms_alias` string and deprecating it? and only create new resource when `var.kms_region != ""`?

liam: proposal: add `kms_alias_v1` resource when `var.kms_alias != ""` and `kms_alias_v2` when new object provided. Use `count = var.kms_alias != "" ? 1 : 0` pattern.

tariq: also for provider alias, we can avoid adding it by using `for_each` on provider config or conditional provider block -> but TF doesn't allow conditional providers. Alternative: keep single provider and use `aws_kms_alias` with `provider = aws` and set `region = var.kms.region` via `alias(resource)`? (not ideal)

maya: another quick mitigation: run `terraform state mv` in canary to preserve old resource id to new resource name, then resume apply. That avoids replace:
```
terraform state mv module.gpupool.aws_kms_alias.alias module.gpupool.aws_kms_alias.alias_v2
```

jen: CI doesn't allow manual state ops in gitops. We need a code path that doesn't force state rename for non-interactive apply.

serena: idea: add a compatibility boolean `var.kms_compat_mode = true` default true, when true keep old resource name and create new attributes as locals. Then deprecate in next major.

liam: regarding cost, revert gpupool defaults to previous values and add `var.enable_spot_fallback` default true.

tariq: +1 to compat flag + keep defaults. I'll make a patch and open PR to revert defaults and add `kms_compat_mode` + docs and a migration guide.

maya: thanks. Also add a `migration.md` snippet in module root with `terraform state mv` steps and a canary checklist: run canary in us-west-2 and eu-west-1 with 1 replica first.

ops-bot: deploy-bot noted: canary apply failed at 2026-11-02T14:22:13Z, blocking promotion.

jen: I'll hold the promotion and notify security for KMS review if we change alias shape. @security-team FYI.

tariq: PR: https://git.company/redwood/tf-modules/pulls/987 — will include plan and migration notes. ping me for reviews.

maya: thanks — let's try to avoid manual state ops. If needed we'll do an automation job that runs state mv with review step.

liam: I'll run cost delta calc once PR's up.

serena: tagging this thread: kms, gpupool, gitops, terraform
